title: India And Climate Change
definition: India's climate change framework is defined by the principle of Common But Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR) and the pursuit of 'Panchamrit' goals to balance rapid economic development with environmental sustainability.
importanceInUpsc: Climate change is a perennial theme in GS Paper III (Environment) and GS Paper II (International Relations/Governance), focusing on India's NDCs, energy transition, and disaster resilience.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of India And Climate Change.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
